incremental.evidence: A read starts at the index its cursor names; test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 resumes from a cursor and gets only the turns added after it.

stableTurnIds.evidence: Each turn is given its id when it is added and keeps it; test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 reads twice, and in chunks, and compares every id.

timestamps.evidence: Each turn is stamped with the time it was added; test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 requires a time on every turn.

roles.evidence: Each turn is added with its role; test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 compares every role with what was added.

partialTurns.evidence: A turn is added whole and never changed; test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 never sees one id twice across resumed reads.

mutableHistory.evidence: Turns are only ever added, except by the fixture's Rotate, which the source reports as a reset; test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 checks a re-read begins with every turn read before.
